claim: Joint local planning and adaptive allocation, with an explicit contract for realizing planned subject increments at actual native keys; equality-constrained writing itself is prior work.
science_invariants: All configured eligible layers remain optimization variables and may reenter after a zero allocation.
Native rewrite/KL sentences, tokenization, injection sites, NLL/KL reductions and entry teacher remain unchanged.
V12 shared relative budget, EfficiencyAdam, independent request states and last evaluated terminal candidate remain unchanged.
No new reference/replay/pulse/locality objective or validation-driven strength calibration.
Actual upper keys are recomputed after this branch's lower writes.
All original request constraints remain, including zero-target columns and repeated occurrences.
History is appended once at every eligible layer from native rewrite-only final mean keys, even when a layer update is zero.
Logical batch is one joint writer problem, independent of execution microbatches.

metric.definition: A = sym(lambda_C * C0 + H_entry), calculated in FP64
metric.symmetrization: Explicit energy-metric definition; record absolute and relative skew of stored inputs.
metric.requirement: Symmetric positive definite; Cholesky failure is technical failure, not a request/layer pruning rule.

MD.name: native_mean_direct
MD.keys: Native nested mean over rewrite contexts, one column per original request

CD.name: native_context_direct
CD.keys: Every native fit row's subject key where that request's delta is injected; current profile includes rewrite6 and KL1
CD.target: T[:,j]=D[:,owner(j)]; KL has owner D, not zero
CD.weights: w_j=1/(B_t*q_owner(j)), with q_r the actual injection-row count
CD.weight_scope: Writer hidden-error geometry only; never substitute for native NLL/KL weights. Compatible exact solutions are independent of positive constraint weights.

writer.objective_priority_2: Among priority-1 minimizers, minimize tr(U A U^T)
writer.whitening: A=L L^T; X=solve(L,K sqrt(W)); Z=T sqrt(W)
writer.solution: U=Z X^+ L^-1, implemented using SVD/QR-SVD and right triangular solve, never explicit inverse
writer.rank_cutoff: tau=eps64*max(X.shape)*sigma_max; retain singular values strictly greater than tau
writer.zero_rank: Update is zero; nonzero target is range-projected rather than exact
writer.compatibility: Record ||Z-Z_hat||; compatible duplicates allowed, conflicting targets remain measurable approximation
writer.numerical_verification: Record ||U K sqrt(W)-Z_hat|| separately from target incompatibility; compatibility alone does not verify the computation
writer.accepted_approximation: A numerically verified, finite range-LS result is committed with its exact status and residual. Rank or target incompatibility alone does not reject/prune the layer or request.
writer.unaccepted_computation: Failed projected-target identity, non-SPD metric, nonfinite output, wrong cast/orientation, failed local-additivity parity or failed rollback is technical failure.
writer.zero_target_columns: Always retained; drop no columns based on plan support
writer.zero_layer: If entire layer D is exactly zero, U=0 may skip solve; final history append still mandatory
writer.retained_subspace_objective: When positive singular values are discarded: U=Z X_tau^+ L^-1 solves the lexicographic problem restricted to whitened V=V Q_tau Q_tau^T. It is not the unrestricted full-X least-squares optimum.
writer.weights_numerical_scope: Positive weights preserve the mathematical compatible exact solution, but may change the numerical retained subspace. Sum-one weights and cutoff are fixed in this run.

precision.current_model_profile: FP32 frozen model and planned increments; native FP32 cast/add of FP64 update
precision.effective_update: U_eff=float64(W_new)-float64(W_old); record separately from ideal U and cast(U)

model_action_qualification_tolerance.scope: Ideal-to-effective action and native local-additivity parity; not a gate on unavoidable target range residual
model_action_qualification_tolerance.reference: ideal U K for effective-weight action comparison; U_eff K for actual native hidden-difference comparison

guarantee_limits: Exact applies only to compatible constraints in the retained subspace and verified numerical tolerance; FP32 applied realization is separately measured.
Context-direct corrects U k_actual - delta, not inherited actual-versus-virtual base state mismatch.
Shared .75 planning budget is not a bound on all-token model drift or weight energy.
Mean exact does not imply canonical/context exactness.
Minimum A-energy is a preservation proxy, not a locality or retention guarantee.
No assertion of equal final strength, lower total energy, fewer batch-level layers or better accuracy.
Rank truncation and float casting may prevent exact realization; errors and affected requests must remain in all metrics.

model_benchmark_batch_contract.source_of_dimensions: ModelAdapter and actual row metadata; no fixed layer count, widths, B or context count in solver
required_adapter_validation: linear-write output maps additively to injection space
model_benchmark_batch_contract.large_B: Support exact or range-LS joint problem within qualified resource limits; never silently change logical B or split into independent writes
model_benchmark_batch_contract.tail: Preserve actual last partial batch and its own original occurrences
model_benchmark_batch_contract.unsupported_case: Report the missing adapter capability or resource requirement; do not assert universal architectural support.

implementation.namespace: project/run_scripts/jlz_realized_writer (new, not implemented by this design task)

functions.capture_native_sites: Capture key/hidden/owner/role/lookup for all injection rows; keep separate rewrite-only native means
functions.build_constraints: MD native means or CD repeated owner D, positive sum-one weights, zero-target columns retained
functions.prepare_metric: FP64 symmetric A and Cholesky with provenance/skew diagnostics
functions.solve_realized: FP64 SVD/QR-SVD, fixed cutoff, geometry and numerical verification, ideal energy
functions.apply_sequential: Fresh actual state per layer, direct target, native cast/apply and realized action
functions.commit_history: Final rewrite-only mean Gram once at all eligible layers
functions.matched_plan_probe: Single frozen plan, branch-local actual states, full RAM restore, no extra fit
functions.reduce_telemetry: Per-request/context realization and both preference/strict-ACC paired retention

conditional_allocation_guarantee: If every eligible layer realizes D at each constrained subject key and total plan norm is nonzero, direct action norm / entry anchor shares equal planned u norm shares. This is not a decomposition of final cumulative hidden change or task contribution.
zero_plan_share: null + NO_PLANNED_EDIT; record anchor-normalized action leakage without dividing by zero; preserve task/evaluation denominator
